title: VEIP Reason Code Registry v0.1
description: Frozen machine-readable registry of all 13 core reason codes for VEIP v0.1. Defines exact trigger conditions, emission statuses, dimension impacts, state prohibitions, evaluation phases, and deterministic template parameter bindings.

reason_codes.summary: Evidence observation missing required subject_ref or extent_ref requested by evaluation target.
reason_codes.trigger_condition: EvidenceReference.subject_ref is absent when subject binding is required, OR EvidenceReference.extent_ref is absent when the evaluation target declares an extent_ref that must be matched.
reason_codes.template: Evidence item '{evidence_id}' lacks required subject_ref or extent_ref for assertion predicate matching.

reason_codes.summary: Provided payload SHA-256 digest does not match calculated SHA-256 digest over JCS-canonicalized evidence payload.
reason_codes.trigger_condition: evidence.payload is present AND SHA-256(RFC8785_JCS(evidence.payload)) != evidence.payload_sha256. (Note: Absence of evidence.payload makes normalized-payload digest verification UNAVAILABLE, and does not emit EVIDENCE_DIGEST_MISMATCH).
reason_codes.template: Evidence item '{evidence_id}' payload_sha256 mismatch. Declared '{declared_hash}', computed '{computed_hash}'.

reason_codes.summary: Receipt nonce has already been observed in evaluation context replay snapshot.
reason_codes.trigger_condition: evaluation_context.replay_snapshot is present AND evidence.receipt.nonce is present in evaluation_context.replay_snapshot.observed_receipt_nonces. (Note: Absence of replay_snapshot yields UNAVAILABLE for replay checking, not RECEIPT_REPLAYED).
reason_codes.template: Receipt nonce '{nonce}' in evidence '{evidence_id}' was previously observed in replay snapshot.

reason_codes.summary: Referenced execution or outcome evidence ID is missing from evidence pack.
reason_codes.trigger_condition: An ID listed in execution_evidence_refs or outcome_evidence_refs is not found in evidence_pack.references.
reason_codes.template: Evidence reference '{evidence_id}' listed in request is missing from evidence pack references.

reason_codes.summary: Receipt-to-run execution binding not evaluateable in pure core v0.1.
reason_codes.trigger_condition: Reserved for future schema iterations containing in-receipt run identity bindings. Never emitted by pure core v0.1.
reason_codes.template: Evidence '{evidence_id}' run_id '{run_id}' does not match receipt execution run identity.

reason_codes.summary: Evidence reference target subject or extent does not match assertion request scope.
reason_codes.trigger_condition: EvidenceReference.subject_ref or EvidenceReference.extent_ref does not match assertion or requested outcome subject/extent.
reason_codes.template: Evidence '{evidence_id}' target scope ('{evidence_subject}', '{evidence_extent}') does not match evaluation target ('{target_subject}', '{target_extent}').

reason_codes.summary: Assertion extent_ref is not active in evaluation context scope registry snapshot.
reason_codes.trigger_condition: evaluation_context.scope_registry_snapshot is present AND target extent_ref is present AND extent_ref is not found in evaluation_context.scope_registry_snapshot.active_extents. (Note: Absence of scope_registry_snapshot yields UNAVAILABLE, not EXTENT_MATCHES_NOTHING).
reason_codes.template: Requested extent_ref '{extent_ref}' is not registered in active scope registry snapshot.

reason_codes.summary: Evidence timestamp violates currentness rules evaluated at evaluation_timestamp.
reason_codes.trigger_condition: evaluation_context.currentness_rules contains an applicable rule AND evidence.observed_at age exceeds maximum_age_seconds or falls outside valid_from / valid_until window. (Note: Absence of an applicable currentness rule yields UNAVAILABLE for currentness, not EVIDENCE_STALE).
reason_codes.template: Evidence '{evidence_id}' observed at '{observed_at}' violates currentness rule '{rule_id}'.

reason_codes.summary: Evidence channel_ref is not listed in active channel warrant snapshot.
reason_codes.trigger_condition: evidence.channel_ref is present AND evaluation_context.channel_warrant_snapshot is present AND evidence.channel_ref is not found in evaluation_context.channel_warrant_snapshot.bound_channels.
reason_codes.template: Channel '{channel_ref}' in evidence '{evidence_id}' is not listed in channel warrant '{warrant_id}'.

reason_codes.summary: Channel binding could not be proven for evidence item.
reason_codes.trigger_condition: evidence.channel_ref is absent OR evaluation_context.channel_warrant_snapshot is absent.
reason_codes.template: Provenance channel binding for evidence '{evidence_id}' could not be established.

reason_codes.summary: Host-authored interpretation lacks computable derivation in pure core v0.1.
reason_codes.trigger_condition: Reserved for host-derivation map extensions in future engine profiles. Never emitted by pure core v0.1.
reason_codes.template: Host-derived assertion '{field_or_context}' is not provenance-bound to evidence capable of supporting the asserted fact.

reason_codes.summary: No valid outcome evidence observed matching requested outcome proposition.
reason_codes.trigger_condition: Reserved for future engine profiles or schema revisions supplying a typed proposition/evidence relation. Never emitted by pure core v0.1 (where absence of a typed proposition matcher yields outcome = UNAVAILABLE).
reason_codes.template: Outcome proposition '{proposition}' was not established by provided evidence.

reason_codes.summary: Channel independence ceiling enforced for pure core v0.1.
reason_codes.trigger_condition: Evaluated under pure core v0.1 engine (institutional cross-channel independence warrants unintegrated).
reason_codes.template: Channel independence dimension strictly bounded to NOT_ESTABLISHED under core engine v0.1.
